mapper.insert: insert into mock_account (account_no, account_type, owner_id, available_cent, frozen_cent, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{accountNo}, #{accountType}, #{ownerId}, #{availableCent}, #{frozenCent}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from mock_account where id = #{id} for update
select * from mock_account where account_type = #{accountType} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
